correctness.rationale: The size-at-least-three general position sets are proved exactly equal to the independent sets. The independence polynomial follows from three disjoint cases according to whether neither spine vertex, x, or y is selected, and the only missing general-position pairs are the 3r+1 edges. Strict log-concavity is certified by an explicit positive formula for the independence-polynomial coefficient differences, together with separate positive checks at the indices affected by the degree-two correction. The exhaustive verifier independently confirms the full set classification and coefficient inequalities for r=2..8.

value.rationale: The general position polynomial literature explicitly treats unimodality and log-concavity as structural questions. Square-page books form a standard infinite generalized-theta family and a natural Cartesian product K_{1,r} Cartesian-product K_2. The theorem gives a closed all-set polynomial and the stronger strict log-concavity property, going materially beyond the previously known scalar maximum.
